name: Malla (Spain)
description: Lozengy of yellow and black in three rows of six whole black lozenges, within a red bordure.
history: The flag was approved on 19 May 1998 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, lozengy of yellow and black with three rows each of six whole black lozenges, and a red bordure 1/18 of the length thick.

features.role: lozengy of three rows of six whole black lozenges
